standard_prerequisites: the base change setup for pairs (A1, I1) to (A2, I2) of Noetherian rings with V(I1 A2) = V(I2) and the base change algebra B2 (remark-base-change, equation-C-prime)
the cotangent complex vanishing criterion and its persistence under base change (definition-rig-etale-homomorphism and lemma-zero-after-modding-out, delivered as its own card)
commensurability of ideals with equal radical in a Noetherian ring: I2^c is contained in I1 A2 for some c >= 0
core_obligations: If B1 is rig-etale over (A1, I1), then the base change B2 is rig-etale over (A2, I2).
The proof combines the cotangent complex vanishing persistence lemma with the rig-etale homomorphism definition and the commensurability inclusion.
proof_roadmap: Transfer the vanishing of multiplication by f1 from B1 to B2 via the persistence lemma.
Use the definition of rig-etale homomorphisms and the commensurability of I2 with I1 A2 to conclude.
difficulty_reason: H2: a three-input base change argument chaining vanishing persistence with the homomorphism definition.
